conflictResolution.note: Isolated Git merge/rebase; native trusted mouse, keyboard and beforeinput. Large-page samples include MergeView setup but exclude Git reads and physical paint. Dispatch samples are synchronous, not end-to-end key latency.

excludedRuns.reason: An earlier interrupted release-check run failed the focus/composition guard during candidate native input. No measurements from that attempt are reused; logs remain local.

A second attempt stopped at the native image-drag assertion. The image input harness was changed to CDP mouse events with coordinate checks and explicit hover targeting; the standalone 42-check image suite then passed. This attempt is also excluded in full.

A third attempt stopped when direct timing-test fixture staging collided with a background status index lock. The fixture now waits for active refresh and suspends automatic refresh around its direct index changes, matching other isolated UI fixtures. All measurements from that attempt are excluded.

A fourth attempt reproduced the index-lock conflict in diff navigation despite fixture refresh guards. An isolated stale-stat probe proved that ordinary git status rewrites index bytes. Candidate status queries now set GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; a real Git regression test verifies untouched index bytes, live edit detection, writer-lock rejection and successful explicit staging. All results from before this runtime fix are excluded.
